cards.text: Paul is wrapping up his letter to the believers in Colossae (Colossians 1:2), and friend, we have reached the thank-you list. This is the end of the awards speech, where EVERYBODY gets a name. First up is Tychicus, a brother Paul is sending their way.

cards.question: Paul is sending Tychicus to the Colossians. What's Tychicus going to tell them?
News isn't the only reason for the trip. Paul sends Tychicus to the Colossians so he may ___ their hearts.

cards.text: Tychicus isn't coming alone. Paul sends Onesimus with him, a faithful and beloved brother, because before group chats, THIS was the group chat, and it knocked on your door.

cards.question: Onesimus is traveling with Tychicus. Paul tells the Colossians that Onesimus is one of their own.

cards.text: Now the greetings come pouring in, and Paul reads them off like the guy who grabbed the mic at a wedding reception and is NOT giving it back. Aristarchus sends his greetings first.

cards.question: Aristarchus sends greetings to the Colossians. Paul calls him his fellow ___.

cards.text: Mark sends greetings too, the cousin of Barnabas, the man who once traveled with Paul (Acts 13:2-4). And the Colossians already have instructions about Mark.

cards.question: The Colossians already got instructions about Mark. What were they?

cards.text: One more greeting comes from Jesus, who is called Justus. Different man, same name, and I PROMISE you somebody in Colossae read that line twice.

cards.question: Paul says Aristarchus, Mark and Justus are the only Jews among his fellow workers for the kingdom of God.
Aristarchus, Mark and Justus mean a lot to Paul. What does he say they've been to him?

cards.text: Next greeting comes from Epaphras, a servant of Christ Jesus, and just like Onesimus, he's one of the Colossians. Hometown guy, far from home, and he has NOT forgotten the folks back home.

cards.question: Epaphras is with Paul, far from Colossae. What does Paul say Epaphras is always doing for the Colossians?

cards.text: WRESTLING. Not a quick prayer on the way out the door, friend: this man is ON THE MAT, praying they'll stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.

cards.question: Paul vouches for Epaphras. He says Epaphras goes to great pains for the Colossians and nobody else.

cards.text: Epaphras goes to great pains for the people in Laodicea and Hierapolis too, so that man's prayer list has a prayer list. Then two more names send greetings, Luke and Demas, and one of them comes with a job title.

cards.question: Luke and Demas send greetings to the Colossians. Paul calls Luke the beloved ___.

cards.text: A DOCTOR on the crew! Then Paul flips it around and tells the Colossians to greet the brothers in Laodicea, and a woman named Nympha.

cards.question: Paul wants the Colossians to greet Nympha. What does he say meets at her house?

cards.text: A whole church meeting in her house, so her living room is the sanctuary and I bet her couch is the front row. Next, Paul gives orders about this very letter.

cards.question: Once the Colossians have read Paul's letter, what does he want them to do with it?

answers.text: Have it read in the Laodicean church
Keep it safe until Paul comes
Copy it out for every family

cards.question: Paul also wants the Colossians to read the letter from Laodicea.

cards.text: It's a letter SWAP, friend: forward this one to the other group, and read the one they forward you. Then Paul has a message for one man, Archippus.

cards.question: Paul tells the Colossians to pass a message to Archippus. Archippus should ___ the ministry he received in the Lord.

cards.text: That's a sticky note on your monitor that just says FINISH THE THING. Then Paul takes the pen himself and writes this greeting in his own hand.

cards.question: Paul signs off the letter in his own hand with one request. What does he ask the Colossians to remember?

cards.text: And his very last words: “Grace be with you.” No “best regards,” no “sent from my phone,” just GRACE, and I am stealing that for every cookie box I seal.

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 16 quotes "sent from my phone", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The word 'because' gives a reason why Paul sends Onesimus ('because before group chats, THIS was the group chat'). Colossians 4:9 doesn't give that reason. It only says Paul is sending him and that they will tell the Colossians everything.

rule.text: **Reasons:** He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.

findings.problem: The core action in Colossians 4:10 is Paul passing along other people's greetings. The comparison is a guest who grabs the mic at a wedding and won't give it back, which is about hogging the floor. The actions don't match, and the joke reads as a jab at Paul instead of laughing with his situation.

rule.text: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

findings.problem: The joke 'that man's prayer list has a prayer list' says Epaphras prays for Laodicea and Hierapolis. Colossians 4:13 says he 'goes to great pains' for them. The wrestling in prayer in 4:12 is only for the Colossians. The image also doesn't click instantly.

rule.text: **Don't stretch the text.** Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

findings.problem: The right answer 'A church' is two words. The wrong answers 'A council of elders' and 'A school of prophets' are four words each. The short right answer stands out.

rule.text: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone.
